header: Contact channels as cards or rows
subheader: Chat, phone, email, help centre, status page or a walk-in counter.
lead: One style gives each channel a card, the other a row with a line below. Nothing else changes between the two.
note: Use tel: and mailto: links so phones open the right app. Put opening hours in each entry, not in this note.

channels.title: A tel: entry
channels.description: The number goes in the description, the tel: link on the title.

channels.title: A mailto: entry
channels.description: Add a response time your team can keep.

channels.title: An always-open entry
channels.description: Help pages are open all the time, so hours belong in each row, not in the band.

channels.title: A walk-in entry
channels.description: Address and opening hours, in the same format as the other entries.
